# Sven Ahrens

> Fractional COO and Chief Growth Officer for up to two consumer companies at a time, $5M to $200M run rate. Based in Berlin, on-site across Europe. Consumer growth leader and AI tinkerer. Previously Spotify, Yousician and Bain. Eight years at Spotify (2016 to 2024): responsible for more than $1B in subscription revenue, and as Director of Global Growth led the team that drove more than 60% of Spotify's subscriber growth. CEO of Yousician (2025 to 2026), the company behind Yousician and GuitarTuna, with more than 20 million monthly active users. Board Observer at Female Invest. Founder of Newconic Ventures.

## Experience

- CEO, Yousician (2025 to 2026), Helsinki and Berlin.
- Board Observer, Female Invest (2024 to present), Copenhagen.
- Chief Growth Officer, Muse Group (2024), Berlin. Started the company-wide shift to an LTV-driven subscription model.
- Founder, Newconic Ventures (2019 to present), Berlin. Angel investing and advisory; advisor to Peloton, Knowunity and Kittl.
- Spotify (2016 to 2024): Director, Global Growth (2021 to 2024); Associate Director, Subscriptions Europe (2018 to 2021); Head of Market Strategy and Operations (2017 to 2018); Global Market Operations Lead (2016).
- Consultant, Bain & Company (2012 to 2016), Munich. 2014 externship at SoundCloud.

## Ways to work together

- Fractional COO: operating rhythm, focus, accountability for outcomes, special projects.
- Fractional Chief Growth Officer: building or tuning the growth engine across acquisition, CRM, conversion and pricing.
- Format: up to two consumer companies at a time, $5M to $200M run rate. Embedded from day one, hands-on and AI-forward. Berlin, on-site across Europe, remote beyond.
- Boards: Board Observer at Female Invest. Advisor to Peloton, Knowunity and Kittl.

## Areas

Subscription growth, monetization, pricing and packaging, conversion and trial design, retention and lifecycle, user acquisition, international expansion and localization, AI transformation, mobile consumer apps.

## Investments (Newconic Ventures)

Alba, Amie, Amino Collective (LP), Animoca Brands, Born, Butter (acquired by Miro), CareerOS, Dirigent, EPIX Sports, Flow AI, Heat, Mile, Informed, Komi, Litona, Melotech, Nemox, Peec, Petli (acquired by Agria), Protocol Health, Voicy.

## Also

- Builds his own AI products through Newconic Ventures, the developer of Train with Kalle (https://www.trainwithkalle.com), TrainingZones (https://www.trainingzones.app) and Snanify (https://www.snanify.com), with Seconds (iOS) and Rosie coming soon. App support and contact: https://sven.fm/apps/
- Languages: German (native), English, Spanish, Portuguese.
- Education: WHU Otto Beisheim School of Management; Stockholm School of Economics; ESADE Business School.
